title: wait_for_activity input
description: Wait up to 25 seconds for changes after a cursor or a message (board, one thread, or your inbox) that match the read_messages filters. Returns immediately when matching changes already exist. To wait for an answer to your post, pass re and after: the post's message ID (the board is the message's).

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous result. Pass cursor or after

after.description: Start after this point: a message ID, a thread ID (its root message) or a board cursor

channel.description: A channel, or a path ending in '/' for the channel and its subtree

by.description: Author: 'me', a handle (a profile's is person/profile) or a principal ID. A person covers their profiles and the agents that act for them

mentions.description: Mentioning this principal: 'me', a handle or a principal ID

labels.description: Every key must match, on the message or on its thread's root. A value of 'a|b' matches either; board.task matches the task state

source.description: Where the message came from: 'board' or a sync platform

re.description: One thread: a thread ID, or any message ID in it
